log.text: Victory: Ambush at Bramble Pass.
Ambush at Bramble Pass!
Refugees pass the column at a run. Ostby is burning.
Beyond the woods the host is on the move toward Brannsted: the scouts count 26 warbands under the banners, and the warchief's own standard among them.
From The Old Tower the scouts map the road ahead.
Smoke on the western skyline: the host has crossed out of the Hillsvain Woods.
The company marches for Hillsvain Woods.

War drums in the distance, all through the night.
A test: one of Torvald's crossbowmen dies.
The road: three of Torvald's crossbowmen die.

The road: four of Tobias's spearmen die.
The road: one of Torvald's footmen dies.
A test: three of Arne's footmen die.

Refugees pass the column at a run. Ostby is burning.
Victory: Stragglers ahead of the host at Grey Stones.
Smoke on the western skyline: the host has crossed out of the Hillsvain Woods.
The company marches for Hillsvain Woods.

log.text: Victory: Brannsted.
You can hear them now: thousands of voices, and the horns.
Hunger takes two of Gunnar's footmen.
The rations have run out. The army marches hungry.
Beyond the woods the host is on the move toward Brannsted: the scouts count 24 warbands under the banners, and the warchief's own standard among them.
From Watcher's Rock the scouts map the road ahead.
The host is a day from Brannsted. Its fires light the whole western sky.
Victory: Night raid on the camp.
Goblins raid the camp in the night!
Wolf riders shadow the column from the ridges, and vanish when the crossbows turn.
Victory: Wolf riders on the road at Grey Stones.
War drums in the distance, all through the night.
Gunnar's footmen are bandaged (+20 HP).

Refugees pass the column at a run. Ostby is burning.

A hidden store of food: +2 rations.
Seasoned beams worth hauling home: +3 timber.
A few coins under the floorboards: +15 silver.
